data.name: BUG SQUASH
data.detailed_description:
The bugs are coming. When a mutation causes insects to grow out of control, you are called in as humanity's last line of defense. As Captain Botas, you command customizable combat tanks designed to hold back the horde and protect vital Command Centers from destruction.

BUG SQUASH combines the strategic depth of tower defense with intense vehicular combat and deep customization systems. Choose your chassis, outfit your tank with devastating weapons and tactical modules, then defend against increasingly dangerous waves of mutated creatures.

Key Features

Deep Tank Customization

  • Three distinct chassis types: Light Scout (fast and agile), Medium Warrior (balanced), or Heavy Fortress (armored powerhouse)

  • Multiple equipment slots for weapons, defensive systems, utility modules, and special attacks

  • Weight management system that creates meaningful trade-offs between firepower and mobility

  • Unlock and upgrade new equipment as you progress through the campaign

Intense Wave Defense Combat

  • Defend critical Command Centers against relentless enemy swarms

  • Strategic positioning and tactical use of abilities determine victory or defeat

  • Dynamic enemy AI that targets both players and structures

  • Progressive difficulty with varied enemy types and behaviors

Solo Campaign & Endless Mode

  • Story-driven campaign with escalating challenges

  • Endless wave mode for ultimate survival tests

  • Compete for high scores and push your loadout to its limits

Online Co-op Multiplayer

  • Team up with friends to defend Command Centers together

  • Coordinate tank builds and strategies with your squad

  • Share the chaos of defending against massive enemy waves

Built for Replayability

  • Experiment with countless tank configurations

  • Adapt your loadout to different mission types and enemy compositions

  • Loot-based progression system rewards experimentation

  • Multiple game modes to test your skills
